summary: Iteration 3 fully verified. (B) Pilot invites: POST /api/pilot/invite returns ok=true+8-hex code; GET /api/pilot/invite/{code} returns community + market.name; GET on BADCODE returns 404. (C) Voice: /api/voice/status configured=true; and a REAL TTS -> Whisper round-trip using OpenAITextToSpeech from emergentintegrations (tts-1, alloy, mp3) fed back into POST /api/voice/transcribe succeeded — transcript contained expected words. Regression: DEMO pulse still returns 8 products, /api/signals/interpret still returns a live structured signal, shopper onboard still flips environment to PILOT. Frontend (Playwright on public URL): /network shows the Week-long trends section (data-testid=snapshot-trends) with a recharts price line + availability dot strip + 'Demo historical data' Chip; trend-product-select lists all 8 products and switching updates the chart. /business Onboard tab (biz-tab-onboard) generates a working invite (invite-community-input + invite-generate-button -> invite-link-box containing /join?invite=CODE with Copy + WhatsApp share). Visiting /join?invite=CODE renders invite-banner naming the community + INA Market, and after clicking onboard-role-shopper the community input is pre-filled. Vendor voice tab exposes vendor-mic-button; text flow still opens the interpret dialog and publishes via vendor-confirm-publish-button (saw 'Signal added to your market's pulse' toast).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/pilot/invite: invite codes are only 8 hex chars (uuid4().hex[:8] = 32 bits). Collision risk is small but non-zero; there is no unique index on pilot_invites.code and no retry-on-collision. Recommend adding a unique index and either enlarging to 12 hex chars or retrying on DuplicateKeyError.
server.py /api/pilot/invite has no rate limiting or auth — anyone can spam-create invites and inflate pilot_invites unbounded. Consider a simple per-IP rate limit or a soft cap.

server.py /api/snapshots/trends silently truncates to the last `days` snapshots regardless of actual date gaps (snaps[-days:]). If the daily cron ever misses days, points will still count as N consecutive but with non-contiguous dates. Consider bucketing by date or forward-filling missing days for honest week-long visualisation.

MarketNetwork.jsx TrendsCard initial useState('Tomatoes') is a magic default that only works because DEMO seed always includes Tomatoes. For PILOT/other markets where Tomatoes may be missing, the useEffect corrects it — but there is a brief render where the chart is empty. Consider deriving initial sel from products[0]?.product.

PilotBusiness.jsx Onboard(): navigator.clipboard.writeText is called without a fallback / try-catch. On some in-app browsers (older WhatsApp / iOS) this throws and no error toast fires. Wrap in try/catch and offer a manual-copy fallback.
server.py 289–306: voice_service.transcribe_audio now correctly uses delete=False + finally unlink (previous iteration's concern addressed). Good.

Vendor.jsx: startRec's rec.onstop calls doInterpret(res.transcript, null) with the transcribed text — good. However, if Whisper returns empty string (silent audio), doInterpret still runs; guarded by `if ((!rawText.trim() && !image) || busy) return;` so it's safe. Consider surfacing a friendly 'No speech detected' toast for empty transcripts.
